# sigma_file (Data Source)

Retrieves a Sigma file (inode) by ID. This is a read-only lookup; folders are managed with `sigma_folder`, and workbooks/reports remain data-source-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_file" "example" {
  id = "inode-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Inode ID.

### Read-Only

- `badge` (String) Badge applied to the file.
- `created_at` (String) File creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the member who created the file.
- `description` (String) File description.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the file is archived.
- `name` (String) File name.
- `owner_id` (String) Member ID of the owner.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent folder ID.
- `parent_source_url_id` (String) Source document URL ID for a tenant deployment.
- `parent_url_id` (String) Parent identifier used in Sigma URLs.
- `path` (String) File path.
- `permission` (String) Effective permission.
- `type` (String) File type.
- `updated_at` (String) File update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) ID of the member who last updated the file.
- `url_id` (String) Identifier used in Sigma URLs.
